name: Plan Card with Billing Toggle
description: A single plan card under a gliding monthly/annual switch: slot-reel digits with motion blur, a springy save badge, a seats stepper and a tweened total.

props.name: monthly
props.description: Price per seat per month on monthly billing.

props.name: annual
props.description: Price per seat per month on annual billing.

props.name: description
props.description: One line on who the plan is for.

props.name: unit
props.description: Small print beside the price; ' / ' splits it over two lines.

props.name: saveLabel
props.description: Badge that springs in on annual billing.

props.name: notes
props.description: Billing note under the price; cross-fades on toggle.

props.name: cta / ctaDone
props.description: CTA label and its success label.

props.name: onCheckout
props.description: CTA handler. Return a promise for the loading state.

props.name: seats
props.description: Seats stepper and tweened total. false hides it.
